svg.title: The Himalaya and the Tibetan Plateau
svg.desc: Situation map covering 71.5°E to 93.5°E, 24.5°N to 37.5°N. A reference plate: eight kilometres of relief, and the rivers that leave it. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; SRTM-derived shaded relief.

g.text: H I M A L A Y A
The Himalaya and the Tibetan Plateau
A reference plate: eight kilometres of relief, and the rivers that leave it
Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer
Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; SRTM-derived shaded relief
